title: The Rising Chamber Where Pressure Becomes Ascension

features.name: the-pressure-release
features.desc-on-touch: where the weight learned to rise—you can feel the upward push in the air itself, the chamber breathing out what it held for ages

features.name: the-ascending-trace
features.desc-on-touch: static resolves into clarity only along this line—the path the pressure took when it learned to move, each flicker ascending further than the last

features.name: the-old-weight
features.desc-on-touch: something that stayed, something that chose the ground—a stone that decided not to rise with the pressure, content in its refusal

features.name: the-breathable-ceiling
features.desc-on-touch: the chamber learned to exhale; above, something that was solid has become permeable, teaching the air that walls can be crossings

inscription: what was trapped learns to move; the chamber discovers that pressure resolves not into peace, but into ascension, not into silence

file.note: timestamps of when things learned to rise—some dated, some not, all of them breathing upward
